newsitem.title: USA: Physician in talks for sale of company.
newsitem.headline: Physician in talks for sale of company.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Wednesday it is in talks to sell the company or receive a capital infusion from a venture partner.
The Miami-based health care service provider said that in recent weeks several parties have expressed interest in a transaction. It did not name the parties.
It said Bear Stearns is helping it review its alternatives.
The company also said it had renegotiated its bank loan that was in default and had received an extension on the loan until October 1.
The company said it is pursuing the separation of its property and casualty unit from its HMO operations.
Chief Financial Officer Clifford Donnelly said in a statement the company is "cautiously optimistic" it can reach an agreement with the Florida Department of Insurance regarding the separation.
